## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Palacio Domecq, Pl. Aladro, 2, 11402 Jerez de la Frontera, Cádiz, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Palacio Domecq. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ticket to Palacio Domecq is included on this self-guided walking audio tour through Jerez de la Frontera. Please note that an audio tour inside Palacio Domecq is not provided within this bundle - it is available at the palace as a separate guide.
>
> After you finish exploring Palacio Domecq, this tour leads you to the peaceful Claustros de Santo Domingo, the elegant Teatro Villamarta, and a traditional tabanco where wine and flamenco still feel part of daily life. From there, the route continues through the civic heart of Jerez at City Hall, then back into the city’s Islamic past at the Alcázar.
>
> After a pause in Alameda Vieja, you’ll pass the famous Bodega Tio Pepe and the cathedral before finishing at Bodegas Tradición. Along the way, the most memorable experiences include standing before an 18th-century palace, entering the atmosphere of a historic tabanco, tracing Moorish and Christian layers in the old center, and ending among the wine heritage that made Jerez known around the world.
